faq.q: What is Feria San Bernabé and when is it in 2036?
faq.a: Feria San Bernabé is Marbella's annual fair honouring the city's patron saint, usually held in mid-June. In 2036, it will run from approximately 11 to 16 June. The fair features daytime casetas, evening concerts, and a festive atmosphere across the town – perfect for extending the party onto the water.

faq.q: Can I book a boat party for Feria San Bernabé 2036 now?
faq.a: Yes, you can reserve your yacht charter now via WhatsApp. While specific dates for 2036 are not yet set, we recommend booking early – Feria week is high season in Marbella. A deposit secures your preferred boat and time slot.

faq.q: Which yachts are best for a Feria boat party?
faq.a: For groups up to 12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (24m) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) offer ample deck space and flybridge lounges. For smaller parties (up to 11 pax), the Azimut 39 is a cost-effective option from €749/2h. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. Spanish IVA (21%) is also included. You just bring your guests and music.

faq.q: Can we swim or anchor during the boat party?
faq.a: Absolutely. The skipper can anchor at sheltered coves like Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, or off Cabopino beach. Most charters include a swim stop – just let the crew know your preference. Life jackets and a dinghy are provided.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for Feria charters?
faq.a: Cancellation terms vary by boat and season. Generally, a full refund is available up to 14 days before departure. For bookings made within 14 days of the charter, a 50% cancellation fee applies. Always confirm at booking.

faq.q: Are there any restrictions on music or decorations?
faq.a: You're welcome to bring your own Bluetooth speaker or use the boat's sound system. Decorations are allowed as long as they don't damage the upholstery or leave residue. No confetti or glitter – it's a hazard for marine life.

faq.q: How do I get to Puerto Banús for the charter?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is 6 km south of Marbella town centre, easily reachable by taxi (€15-20 from the Golden Mile) or by driving – there are paid car parks near the port. If you're staying in Marbella, many hotels offer shuttle services to the port.

data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabé 2036 is the perfect excuse to trade the crowded casetas for a private deck on the Mediterranean. With a Marbella yacht charter for Feria San Bernabé 2036, you can enjoy the fair's festive spirit from the water – swimming stops, chilled cava, and panoramic views of La Concha. Whether you're celebrating with friends or family, our fleet at Boat Rental Marbella has options for every group size and budget.

Why choose a boat party for Feria San Bernabé?

Marbella's fair attracts thousands of visitors each June, and the port area can get busy. A private yacht charter gives you a floating VIP lounge – no queues, no noise restrictions, and your own crew. You control the itinerary: anchor at Cala del Faro for a swim, cruise past the Golden Mile, or simply drift offshore with music. All charters include drinks, snacks, and a licensed skipper, so you can relax from the moment you step aboard at Puerto Banús.

Best yachts for your Feria boat party

Our fleet ranges from compact speedboats to superyachts. For a Feria party, these are the top picks:

  • Mangusta 80 (24m) – 12 guests, €4,719 minimum 4 hours, includes a free jet ski. Flybridge and sunpad ideal for socialising.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) – 12 guests, pricing on request. Spacious flybridge with wet bar.
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m) – 9 guests, from €749/2h. Great value for smaller groups.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m) – 11 guests, from €749/2h. Affordable and well-equipped.

All depart from Puerto Banús. For full details on every boat, visit our fleet page.

Our transparent pricing means no hidden fees. Every charter includes:

Itinerary ideas for your Feria boat party

Most charters last 4–8 hours. A popular route: depart Puerto Banús, head east toward Marbella Marina (15 minutes), then anchor at Cala Cortés for swimming. After lunch, cruise west to Cabopino or Estepona for a sunset return. If you choose the Mangusta 80, your jet ski adds extra fun – explore the coastline at speed.

What to bring and what to expect

Bring swimwear, sunscreen, a towel, and your playlist. The boat's sound system is Bluetooth-compatible. Dress code is casual – no heels on deck. The skipper will brief you on safety and can adjust the itinerary based on weather. Expect water temperatures around 22–24°C in mid-June.

How to book your Feria San Bernabé 2036 charter

Reserve via WhatsApp – we'll confirm availability and send a booking link. A deposit (usually 50%) secures your date. With Feria week being peak season, early booking is advised. For groups larger than 12, we can arrange multiple boats or recommend a superyacht like the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – pricing on request.
